description: A simple jump and run game implemented with various fun levels (including special power-ups) in JavaScript.
changes: Added a shop button to the game interface, allowing players to access the in-game shop which hasn't been developed yet.
Implemented a function to prevent scrolling on the page when using arrow keys or spacebar, enhancing the gaming experience by keeping the focus on the game canvas.
Added new player characters. You can't choose them yet, but they will be available in the shop soon.
Added an asset folder (to public/assets) to organize game assets such as character images and power-up icons which will be used in the shop.
